_comment: KTM Berhad (Malaysia) night trains, read by scripts/adapters/ktmb.mjs.

The timetable is data.gov.my's GTFS Static for KTMB (api.data.gov.my/gtfs-static/ktmb): every Intercity and ETS trip with its stops, times and positions. trip_id is the train number and route_id the service, so the allowlist is a list of routes and the clock does the rest: a trip on one of `routes` is a night train when it leaves at or after `minDepartureHour` and runs past midnight for at least `minMinutes`. That keeps the Ekspres Rakyat Timuran 26/27 (JB Sentral – Tumpat, KTM's one train with sleeping berths — 'Superior Night Sleep', ADNS) and leaves out the ERT route's midday Merapoh – JB Sentral working (trip 1021, 12:00) as well as the overnight ETS runs to Padang Besar and Hat Yai, which are seated and on another route.
Station names: the feed writes them in capitals ('JB SENTRAL'); the adapter title-cases them ('JB Sentral', 'Kuala Lipis'). `stationNames` holds the few that title-casing gets wrong.

stationNames._comment: Feed spelling (any case) → the name the map uses, where title-casing alone is wrong.
